name: Document Preview
description: Previews office/PDF documents in the browser using the Google Docs viewer.
project_description:
Module for preview documents in different formats: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt.

 Based on Google Docs API. Provides custom field formatter with 2 view types:

 - Simplebox

 - Modal window

 TUTORIAL: 
 1. Install this module

2. Create a new media type (for example "File")

3. Set "Document Preview Formatter" for File field

4. Create a custom block type, add filed of your media media type

5. Add formats for your field: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt

6. Done. Add your block to the page or Layout Builder

 Important! Google Docs API doesn't work on local environments!
